# GPRM - GitHub Profile README Generator

> GPRM (GitHub Profile README Maker) is a free, open-source, no-code tool built by Bhalli B for creating professional, data-driven GitHub Profile READMEs. It features AI-powered bio generation, 200+ tech stack icons, live GitHub stats integration, and multiple README templates.
It includes an AI bio generator, 200+ tech icons, dynamic GitHub stats cards, and premium templates.

## Short description
GPRM helps developers create clear, recruiter-friendly GitHub profile READMEs with templates, AI bios, and stats cards.

GPRM helps software developers, open-source contributors, and tech professionals build GitHub profile READMEs in minutes without writing markdown by hand. The tool is a step-by-step no-code editor: Profile → Skills → Analytics → Templates → Export.

Key features:
- AI-powered bio generation with selectable tone (professional, witty, casual, minimal)
- 200+ searchable tech stack icons across frontend, backend, languages, databases, cloud/DevOps, AI/data, tools, design, mobile, and testing
- Live GitHub stats, streak stats, top-languages, contribution graph, and trophy widgets
- Seven README templates (Minimalist, Data-Driven, Developer, Creative, Compact, Terminal, Corporate)
- Real-time, editable markdown preview before export
- Copy-to-clipboard or direct .md file download
- No signup, no account. All processing happens client-side in the browser; nothing is stored on GPRM's servers

GPRM is open source under the MIT license. Issues, feature requests, and contributions are welcome on GitHub.
